documents.whyTitle: Why do we need these documents?
documents.whyText: In compliance with LCEN regulations and the KYC requirements of payment marketplaces, we need to verify your identity and business. Your documents are encrypted at-rest and never shared with clients.
documents.noteText: Typical verification time: 24 business hours. You can prepare your storefront in the meantime.
documents.idCardInstructions: Front and back if national ID — valid national ID, passport, or residence permit
documents.ribInstructions: In the name of your business or sole trader — no personal bank accounts
documents.kbisInstructions: Less than 3 months old. Required for SAS, SARL, EURL. Sole traders and auto-entrepreneurs: skip this step.
